WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 4 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.fiscal_year), (d.fiscal_year, cs.region))
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.store_weeks, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region NULLS FIRST

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT n.business_date, n.store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS mine
  FROM net_lines n
  WHERE n.business_date IN (SELECT calendar_date FROM dim_date WHERE (fiscal_year='FY2026/27' OR fiscal_year='FY2025/26') AND fiscal_period=1)
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales AS ctl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date IN (SELECT calendar_date FROM dim_date WHERE (fiscal_year='FY2026/27' OR fiscal_year='FY2025/26') AND fiscal_period=1) AND store_id < 900
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, COALESCE(m.store_id, c.store_id) AS store_id, COUNT(*) AS n_days,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(m.mine,0)),2) AS mine, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(c.ctl,0)),2) AS ctl, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(m.mine,0)-COALESCE(c.ctl,0)),2) AS gap
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.business_date=m.business_date AND c.store_id=m.store_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = COALESCE(m.business_date,c.business_date)
GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING ABS(SUM(COALESCE(m.mine,0)-COALESCE(c.ctl,0))) > 0.5
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_line_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_receipt_lines, MIN(sale_date), MAX(sale_date), MIN(etl_loaded_at), MAX(etl_loaded_at), SUM(CASE WHEN net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_lines, SUM(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
GROUP BY 1

WITH x AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ns
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store) s ON s.store_id=r.store_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND r.store_id<900
  GROUP BY 1,2,3)
SELECT a.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.region, cs.format,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN a.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN a.ns END) FILTER (WHERE a.fiscal_week=1),0) AS ty_w1,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.fiscal_year='FY2026/27') AS ty_weeks,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.fiscal_year='FY2025/26') AS ly_weeks,
  ROUND(SUM(ns) FILTER (WHERE a.fiscal_year='FY2026/27'),0) AS ty,
  ROUND(SUM(ns) FILTER (WHERE a.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'),0) AS ly,
  ROUND(100*(SUM(ns) FILTER (WHERE a.fiscal_year='FY2026/27')/SUM(ns) FILTER (WHERE a.fiscal_year='FY2025/26')-1),1) AS g
FROM x a JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=a.store_id AND cs.is_current
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY g

SELECT fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS days, SUM(CASE WHEN is_trading_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trading_days, string_agg(CASE WHEN NOT is_trading_day THEN CAST(calendar_date AS VARCHAR) || ' ' || COALESCE(holiday_name,'') END, '; ') AS closed
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period=1 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
